journey.name: Wear Core Flow
journey.description: Tests the navigation from Categories to Projects and then to Task details on WearOS.

actions.action: Verify that you are on the 'Categories' screen. This is the main screen showing a list of task categories.
Scroll the list if necessary to find a category like 'Work' or 'Personal' and tap on it.
Verify that the project list for the selected category is now displayed. You should see project titles like 'Fix leaking roof' or 'Buy groceries'.
Tap on one of the projects to open its detailed task list.
Verify that the detail screen shows the project title at the top.
Check that the individual tasks for that project are listed below the title. Each task should have a checkbox next to it.
